## History

The Twin Sailors are imaginary characters created by [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), residing among his fictional rock friends at the shore. The oldest Twin Sailor sails on a fantastical journey to the sunset alongside [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) in an enchanted boat. [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) subsequently recounts these imagined adventures with the sailor in a composition letter written to his teacher, [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md).

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P0](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0000), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P1](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0001), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P2](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0002), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P4](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0004), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P6](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0006), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P8](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0008), +22 more_

## Relationships

### [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/paul-irving--twin-sailor.md)

The Twin Sailors are imaginary characters created by [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) as part of his play on the shore. [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) features the oldest Twin Sailor in his creative writing, depicting a fantastical journey to the sunset in an enchanted boat. However, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) acknowledges to his teacher, [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), that these sailors and their adventures are entirely fictional.

- presumed Friend of — imaginary friends who come ashore to talk to him  <sub>[v2 XI Facts and Fancies P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042)</sub>
